verdict.rationale: Resend's own docs say you can point MX records at Resend and process inbound messages via webhooks, and a separate API endpoint lists received emails, so the core inbound flow is first-party. The evidence never documents what the parsed payload contains (headers, body, attachments), and no hands-on report confirms that receiving works. missing for 10: documentation of parsed headers/body/attachments in the webhook or API payload, attachment retrieval, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive email — point MX records at the service and get parsed messages (headers, body, attachments) delivered to my webhook or API

citations.quote: Receive and act on inbound email: point MX records at Resend and process messages via webhooks.
You can list all emails received by your team.
